# AMTV — Apple Music for Android TV & Google TV

> Unofficial, open-source (MIT) Apple Music app for Android TV / Google TV boxes and TVs (Xiaomi Mi Box, Chromecast with Google TV, NVIDIA Shield, Onn, TVs with Google TV). It runs Apple's official web player (music.apple.com) in a WebView and adds a remote-friendly (D-pad) interface on top: Home, Browse, Radio, Library, Search, album/playlist/artist pages, a calm Now Playing screen with lyrics and favorites. Interface in English, German, Spanish, French, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Hindi, Japanese and Simplified Chinese. No DRM circumvention; requires an Apple Music subscription. Android 10+, Widevine.

## Install
- APK (latest release): https://github.com/megarohas/apple-music-android-tv/releases/latest/download/amtv.apk
- Easiest: install "Downloader" from Google Play on the TV, allow Unknown sources, open the APK URL above.
- ADB: `adb install amtv.apk`

## Automation (Android intents)
- Play a station/playlist/album: `adb shell am start -n com.megarohas.amtv/.MainActivity --es play <id>` (ids from Apple Music links: `ra.…` stations, `pl.…` playlists, numeric albums)
- Player: `--es cmd next|prev|pause|play|toggle|favorite|unfavorite`
